original_test_intent: Verify that each populated Type 17 record exposes the approved module part number through a valid SMBIOS string reference, preserves meaningful vendor/revision suffixes, maps to the correct locator/module and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17/string-table data, bind Part Number index/value to locator, manufacturer and serial, validate index/format, preserve raw spacing/suffix text, apply only approved canonicalization, compare trusted inventory/SPD part identity and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the allowed part/variant inventory and reboot plan. No physical module or label inspection is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected part number and permitted variants per populated locator
Rules for right-padding, case, separators and meaningful suffixes/revisions
Policy for blank/placeholder values and empty slots
Trusted inventory/SPD-to-locator mapping and decoder version
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/SPD/inventory; never write identity fields or manipulate DIMMs.
Validate raw string index/range and preserve raw bytes/value before normalization.
Do not strip or wildcard vendor suffixes/revisions unless an explicit equivalence list permits it.
Bind comparison by locator plus serial/manufacturer; record order alone is not identity.
Stop on invalid reference, unresolved variant or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate string reference/format, approved canonical part/variant match, trusted module mapping and pre/post reboot stability.
Do not rewrite fields, over-normalize variants, alter hardware or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-locator parts, allowed variants and exact normalization/equivalence rules.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve unlisted suffixes and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The displayed Part Number is relevant, but grep -A1 loses locator/serial/manufacturer context and cannot validate its string index or variant equivalence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17/string data; report locator/module identity, raw index/value, minimally normalized part, suffix/revision tokens and trusted inventory/SPD comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Part Number scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing, identity writes and module changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate each SMBIOS part-number string reference, retain raw padded text, canonicalize only approved formatting differences, compare full meaningful part/revision identity to trusted locator inventory and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode, SPD decoder and inventory revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Part Number string-index semantics, relevant SPD part-number field definition and approved vendor/AVL inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string integrity, stable module identity, exact variant handling and trusted cross-source comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated/invalid strings, wrong-slot parts and disallowed suffix/revision variants that broad trimming or grep would hide.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-locator approved parts/variants and canonicalization policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different sources may pad or encode the same part differently; only documented formatting normalization is safe, while suffixes can encode real electrical or manufacturing differences.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve an AVL set of equivalent part numbers, but must list the exact accepted variants and coverage implications; wildcarding an entire prefix is not an acceptable override.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator part/variant list and canonicalization policy
Per-locator raw index/value, normalized part and preserved suffix/revision breakdown
Trusted SPD/asset comparison tied by locator/serial/manufacturer
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus canonical part diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Part Number is a clear Type 17 string field; allowed variants and canonicalization are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String and trusted-inventory comparison are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string-index integrity, stable identity and suffix-sensitive trusted comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains per-locator variant safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Constrains normalization so meaningful variants cannot be erased and keeps the verdict engineer-owned.

review_improvement: Prevents an over-trimmed prefix match from accepting a wrong module revision and detects malformed or wrong-slot part strings.
independent_technical_reasoning: String references, token-preserving canonicalization and inventory membership are deterministic software operations once equivalence rules are approved.
